style.styleTitle: Remembrance Angel Personalised Christmas Bauble by No Ordinary Gift
style.toneOfVoice: A personalised memorial Christmas Bauble featuring an elegant angel silhouette design. Personalised with a name and short message, this is the perfect keepsake to remember loved ones at Christmas. Finished off with a scattering of artificial snow. Available with a gold or silver mirror acrylic angel with a frosted acrylic layer behind, fixed to a wooden base. Baubles measure 10cm and are finished with velvet ribbon in your choice of colour. Please note: the personalisation appears on one side only. Please do not include emojis or special characters in your personalisation as they cannot be included on the design. Dimensions(mm): Height: 110 Width: 110 Depth: 110.
